case: PostgreSQL refuses a custom-enum label over the 63-byte limit
contract: Creating a custom enum with a 64-byte ASCII label is refused with SQLSTATE 42602.
A native to_regtype check confirms the failed DDL leaves no partially created enum type.
Together with the 63-byte boundary case, accepted and refused label lengths are pinned against PostgreSQL 16 behavior.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres value_contract_custom_enum_refuses_labels_over_byte_limit -- --ignored --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL enum operators, consumer formats, session/search_path combinations and the broader B3 matrix remain open.
